content: Update project metadata (name, title, icons, identifiers) in package.json, tauri.conf.json, Cargo.toml
Add core dependencies: rusqlite + serde for backend; React + ReactFlow + types for frontend graph UI
Design and implement SQLite schema: stories, characters, stats, nodes, edges, audit_log with user attribution
Create Rust DB module, connection, migrations, basic CRUD models
Implement Tauri commands for stories, characters, nodes/edges, change history
Convert frontend from vanilla TS to React + TS + Vite
Build basic app shell: sidebar (stories), tabs (Graph, Characters, Timeline, Audit)
Integrate React Flow for idea/node graph with add/connect/delete
Wire frontend to call Rust commands for create/save/load
Add simple user identification (name selector) and attribute all changes
Run dev build to verify no errors and basic flow works
